purpose: Frozen, pre-registration holdout for NEWS_INTELLIGENCE_V1_2_COVERAGE_RECOVERY. Models a NEW observation period (17-18 Aug 2026, after the v1.1 15 Jul - 14 Aug window) and replays the REAL production ingestion pipeline (pullPibObservations) under two configurations: v1.2-interventions-off (retries=0, detectRotationGap=false) vs v1.2-interventions-on (retries=2, detectRotationGap=true).
feed_window_model: Each scheduled pull is replayed through the adapter's fetch boundary: the fetcher returns exactly the releases listed for that window (the adapter cannot observe anything beyond what the feed returns). feed_behavior per window: 'ok' (returns releases), 'transient_failure' (first fetch throws, later attempts succeed), 'persistent_failure' (every fetch throws), 'rotation' (feed window has moved forward; its oldest item is newer than the previously ingested newest). ground_truth_releases published inside a rotation gap exist but appear in NO window - modelling the dominant v1.1 miss mechanism (rolling-window rotation; release never in a polled feed). Two rotation scenarios: w5 is a same-day 40-minute feed rotation (gap 11:20-12:00); w6 is the overnight pull gap after 19 hours without a scheduled pull (gap 12:50 Aug 17 - 08:00 Aug 18). Releases 2100060-2100062 (published overnight) and 2100031-2100033 (published inside the w5 rotation gap) appear in no window.

recovery_scopes.retry_recovers: releases in a transient_failure window (I1) - recovered at ingestion level when retries>0.
recovery_scopes.gap_surfaces: releases in a persistent_failure window (fetch-failed gap) and releases inside a rotation gap (rotation gap, I2) - surfaced to the editorial queue as COVERAGE_GAPS; backfill from the PIB archive is the documented operational remedy (adapter-level auto-backfill is out of scope).
recovery_scopes.not_affected: VELT/timing family (median VELT, P90 VELT, positive lead rate, valid comparator rate) - these require external t2 comparators and are unchanged by collection-side interventions; reported N/A for this holdout.
